records.title: 10-K
records.text: The Company’s operating revenue increased by 22.0 percent in 2022 compared to 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Saia’s LTL tonnage also increased 0.9 percent per workday while LTL shipments decreased 0.8 percent per workday for 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The 2022 operating ratio (operating expenses divided by operating revenue) improved to 83.1 percent as compared to 85.4 percent in 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The increase resulted primarily from pricing actions, including a 7.5 percent general rate increase taken on January 24, 2022, for customers subject to general rate increases, in addition to an increase in fuel surcharge revenue and improvements in mix of business.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Consolidated operating income was $470.5 million for 2022 compared to $335.1 million in 2021.
